subject: physics
question_text: Using dimensional analysis, derive an expression for the time period of a simple pendulum.

verification.note: PREDICTED CELL — not asked by either source book. Unit 2 has NO Short Answer or Long Answer section in the Fastrack (pp.4-5) or the TSBIE Basic Learning Material (pp.2-3), so it is authored as a 2-mark VSAQ like every other Unit 2 card. Both the question and the 1+1 mark split are CLAIMS until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms them.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Set up the powers
lines: Assume T depends on length l, mass m and g:
Comparing: M: b = 0,  L: a + c = 0,  T: −2c = 1
steps.why: Comparing the power of each fundamental quantity on both sides turns one equation into three simple ones, which is the whole method.
common_mistakes: Leaving mass out of the assumed form. Getting b = 0 is a result worth showing.

recall.must_convey: That T is assumed to be k times l to the a, m to the b, g to the c, and comparing powers gives b zero, a plus c zero and minus two c equal to one.

steps.memory_tip: Write the assumed product, then match M, L and T one at a time.
steps.margin_note: Show b = 0. It is the result that the period does not depend on mass.

steps.label: The result
lines: c = −½ and a = ½, b = 0, so
steps.why: The method fixes every power but leaves the pure number k undetermined, because a pure number has no dimensions to compare.
common_mistakes: Claiming the method gives T = 2π√(l/g). The 2π must come from experiment or from a full derivation.

recall.must_convey: That T equals k root l over g, and that the constant 2 pi cannot come from dimensional analysis.

steps.memory_tip: The powers come out; the 2π never does. Say that and the answer is complete.
steps.margin_note: The last line about k is worth a mark on its own.

insider_note: The method gives the powers but never the 2π. Say so at the end — it is the honest close and often the mark.
